## Sign-off

Every commit carries `Signed-off-by: Your Name <you@example.com>` matching its
author (`git commit -s`): the [Developer Certificate of
Origin](https://developercertificate.org/). To add it: `git commit --amend -s`
for the last commit, `git rebase --signoff <base>` for several, then push
again.
